# Currency

## Summary
Base-realm ISO currency field with a picker edit UI. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/currency` (default export `CurrencyField`).

## API
- `code` — ISO 4217 currency code (StringField, e.g. USD, MYR, JPY)

The module also exports a `Currency` CardDef for card-instance usage.

## Usage
```ts
import CurrencyField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/currency';

@field settlementCurrency = contains(CurrencyField);
```
For an amount *plus* its currency in one value, use the Amount with
Currency field, which composes this one.
